//: Turborepo 2 runs tasks in STRICT env mode by default: a task sees only the variables declared here. Anything a task genuinely reads must be listed, or it arrives undefined — and the failure lands in CI rather than locally, because a developer shell usually has the variable set anyway. The test task declares DATABASE_URL and friends on the TASK rather than globally so they also feed the cache hash: a run against a different database is not the same run. (`//` is only legal at the top level here, not inside a task.)
